resources.string: Vehicle control is unavailable: this head unit is not a supported Voyah model or its firmware has no identity profile.
Approved comfort, climate, lighting, window and drive-mode commands also work while driving. Doors, trunk, filler flaps, seat memory and lights off need Park at a standstill.
The vehicle reported the requested state.
Part of the request may have been applied. Check the vehicle state.
The result is unknown. Check the vehicle state before trying again.
The vehicle must be stationary for this command.
Vehicle state unavailable. The command was blocked.
This command is forbidden in Settings → Allowed actions.
Every vehicle command is allowed by default. A command you switch off is forbidden for voice, routines and automation; Settings → Allowed actions can also mark it unverified.
This head unit is not a supported Voyah model, so no vehicle commands are available.
